frame.origin: building centre on the ground plane
frame.x: +x streamwise (wind at WD = 0 blows toward +x); slab x in [-0.025, 0.025]
frame.y: +y lateral; slab y in [-0.10, 0.10]; points published on the y <= 0 half
frame.length_scale: model metres (the source states no model:full scale ratio)

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: generated from the readme's stated dimensions 0.05 x 0.20 x 0.20 m, centred on the origin (MP-z_caseB.png)
